decisions.thought: It's a mirror team, so I want a solid core: Garchomp leads with Focus Sash to get Stealth Rock up safely. Sylveon handles opposing Kingambit and Dragonite, and Kingambit gives me a strong late-game wincon with Supreme Overlord.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Mirror team. Bring Garchomp (sash lead, rocks), Kingambit, Gholdengo? Sylveon covers Kingambit/Dragonite. Bring Garchomp, Sylveon, Gholdengo? Kingambit strong too. I'll take Garchomp, Sylveon, Kingambit.

decisions.thought: Garchomp outspeeds and Earthquake is super effective on Kingambit, likely dealing huge damage or a KO with Sash backup if it survives. Setting rocks is slower and Kingambit threatens little back this turn.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: EQ hits Kingambit 4x weak? Dark/Steel: Ground is 2x weak (Steel weak, Dark neutral). Super effective, big damage.

decisions.thought: Dragonite likely has Multiscale, halving the first hit, but Scale Shot is super effective and hits multiple times, likely breaking Multiscale and dealing big damage. Garchomp outspeeds, so no risk of taking a hit first. Earthquake is useless here.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Dragonite likely Multiscale; Scale Shot breaks sash/multiscale and is super effective, Garchomp faster. Scale Shot best.

decisions.thought: Dragonite is at 87% so Multiscale is broken, but it just KO'd Garchomp and outspeeds my slower options. Sylveon resists Dragon Claw and threatens Dragonite hard with Pixilate Hyper Voice, making it the safe pivot.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Dragonite likely Multiscale; Sylveon handles Dragonite well (Hyper Voice Pixilate, resists Dragon). Bring Sylveon.

decisions.thought: Dragonite is faster and will hit Sylveon hard with Dragon Claw, but Hyper Voice is super effective and Multiscale is inactive at 87% HP, likely dealing heavy damage or a KO. Staying in and attacking is the best play.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Dragonite faster, Sylveon takes Dragon Claw hard. Hyper Voice hits Dragonite super effectively (Fairy vs Dragon). Multiscale not active (87%). Do big damage.

decisions.thought: Hyper Voice is resisted (Pixilate makes it Fairy, Steel resists) and Yawn is blocked by Good as Gold. Kingambit threatens Gholdengo with super-effective Iron Head, and Sylveon stays healthy on the bench.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Gholdengo immune to Hyper Voice (Steel/Ghost... Fairy hits Steel not very effective, Ghost immune to Normal—but Pixilate makes it Fairy, so Steel resists). Yawn blocked by Good as Gold. Switch Kingambit? Gholdengo threatens Kingambit with Make Rain... Kingambit resists nothing; Gholdengo likely has Make It Rain which hits Kingambit neutrally. Sylveon is fine vs Gholdengo; Wish/Protect stall? Gholdengo faster. Yawn immune. Best: Wish to keep Sylveon healthy, or switch Kingambit to threaten. Kingambit's Iron Head hits Gholdengo super effectively. Gholdengo may switch. Switch Kingambit seems good.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo is at 58% and Kowtow Cleave is super effective with a Supreme Overlord boost, so it should knock out before or after taking a resisted Make It Rain. Kingambit easily survives that hit.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Gholdengo at 58%, Kowtow Cleave super effective with Supreme Overlord boost likely KOs. But Gholdengo may outspeed and Make It Rain — resisted, Kingambit survives. Kowtow Cleave.

decisions.thought: Dragonite is at 22% and may outspeed Kingambit, so Kowtow Cleave risks taking a hit first. Sucker Punch gets priority and Dragonite will almost certainly attack with Dragon Claw, securing the KO safely.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Dragonite at 22%, Kowtow Cleave likely KOes; Dragonite may outspeed. Sucker Punch safer if it attacks—but Dragon Claw is likely. Sucker Punch +1 priority beats faster Dragonite and likely KOs.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo is at 58% and Kowtow Cleave is super effective with a Supreme Overlord boost, so it likely knocks out before Gholdengo can Make It Rain. Sucker Punch risks a switch or fails. Taking the KO now is safest.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Gholdengo at 58%, Kowtow Cleave super effective with Supreme Overlord boost likely KOs. Sucker Punch risk if it switches. Kowtow Cleave.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo used Protect last turn, so it can't Protect again this turn. Kowtow Cleave is super effective and with Supreme Overlord boost should KO the 58% Gholdengo before it can attack.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Gholdengo at 58%, Kowtow Cleave super effective likely KO. But Gholdengo may Protect again? It used Protect last turn — can't Protect twice in a row. So Kowtow Cleave.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo has Protected three turns in a row, but it can't stall forever and Kowtow Cleave is 4x super effective on its 58% HP — it should KO outright. Sucker Punch fails against Protect, so the reliable pick is Kowtow Cleave.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Gholdengo keeps Protecting; it's at 58%, Kowtow Cleave 4x SE should KO. But it may Protect again (PP 16, used 3). Risk: if Protect, we waste turn. Still Kowtow Cleave is best—Sucker fails vs Protect.
